a: अनुपस्थित — a. Not present, absent, not at hand or near; not current. --तं A word that is not उपस्थित q. v.

a: अनुपसंहारिन् — m. A kind of हेत्वाभास or fallacy in Nyāya, a subdivision of the अनैकांतिकहेत्वाभास; वस्तुमात्रपक्षकोऽनुपसंहारी that is, that which includes every known thing in the पक्ष and thus prevents the corroboration of a general rule of causation by illustrations, positive or negative; as सर्वं नित्यं प्रमेयत्वात्; अत्र सर्वस्यैव पक्षत्वात् प्रमेयत्वं हेतुरनुपसंहारी अन्वये व्यतिरेके वा दृष्टांताभावात्.

genuine

unrequited.

following

s: anuprAsaH

puM, (rasAdyanugatatvena prakarzeRa varRAnAmAsaH nyAsaH, anu + pra + as + GaY .) tulyavarRavinyAsaH । yaTA, -- “varRasAmyamanuprAsaH” iti kAvyaprakASaH ॥ “varRAvfttiranuprAsaH pade pAde viDIyate” । iti kAvyacandrikA । asya vivaraRaM alaNkAraSabde drazwavyam ॥ (“varRasAmyarUpaH SabdAlaNkAraviSezaH, atra varRAnAmeva sAdfSyaM jYeyaM, svaramAtre'pi sAdfSyaM vEcitryABAvAt na gaRitaM । sa tu paYcaviDaH, CekAnuprAso vfttyanuprAsaH SrutyanuprAso'ntyAnuprAso lAwAnuprAsaSceti । anuprAsaH SabdasAmyaM vEzagye'pi svarasya yat” । iti sAhityadarpaRe .)
v: pu॰ anugataH rasAdyanuguRaM prakfzwamAsaM varRanyAsaM samavarRaracanAM samavarRoccAraRaM vA gatasa॰ । alaNkAraprasidDe svaravEzamye'pi samavarRRAnAM tulyaracanArUpe “anuprAsaH SabdasAmyaM vEzasye'pi svarasya yat (sA॰ da॰) ukte SabdAlaNkAraBede । sa ca paYcaDA te ca sodAharaRamuktA darpaRe yaTA “Ceko vyaYjanasaNGasya sakft sAgyamanekaDA” । CekaSCekAnuprAsaH । anekaDeti svarUpataH kramataSca । rasaH sara ityAdikramaBedena sAdfSyaM nAsyAlaNkArasya vizayaH । yaTA “AdAya vakulaganDAnanDIkurvvan pade pade BramarAn । ayameti mandamandaM kAverIvAripAvanaH pavanaH” ॥ atra ganDAnanDIti saMyuktayoH, kAverIvArItyasaMyuktayoH । pAvanaH pavana iti bahUnAM vyaYjanAnAM sakfdAvfttiH । Ceko vidagDaH tatprayojyatvAdeza CekAnuprAsaH । “anekasyEkaDA sAmyamasakfdvApyanekaDA । ekasya sakfdapyeza vfttryanuprAsa ucyate” ॥ ekaDA svarUpata eva na tu kramato'pi । anekaDA svarUpataH kramataSca । sakfdapItyapiSabdAdasakfdapi । yaTA “unmIlanmuDaganDalubDamaDupavyADUtacUtANkurakrIqatkokilakAkalIkalakalErudgorRakarRajvarAH । nIyante paTikEH kaTaM kaTamapi DyAnAvaDAnakzaRaprAptaprARasamAsamAgamarasollAsEramI vAsarAH” । atra rasollAsEramI iti rasayorekaDEva sAgyam । na tu tenEva krameRApi । dvitIye pAde tu kalayorasakft tenEva krameRa ca । praTame ekasya takArasya sakft । rasavizayavyApAravatI varRaracanA vfttistadanugatatvena prakarzeRa vyasanAdDattyanuprAsaH । “uccAryyatvAdyadEkatra sTAne tAluradAdike । sAdfSyaM vyaYjanasyEva SrutyanuprAsa ucyate” ॥ yaTA “dfSA dagDaM manasijaM jIvayanti dfSEva yAH । virUpAkzasya jayinIstAH stumo vAmalocanAH” ॥ atra “jIvayantIti” “yA iti” “jayinIriti” atra jakArayakArayorekatra sTAne tAlO uccAryyatvAt sAdfSyam । eva dantyakaRWyAnAnapyudAhAryyam । eza ca sahfdayAnAmatIva SrutisuKAvahatvAcCrutyanuprAsaH । “vyaYjanaM cedyaTAvasTaM sahAdyena svareRa tu । Avarttyate'ntyayojyatvAdantyAnuprAsa eva tat” ॥ “yaTAvasTamiti” yaTA samBavamanusvAravisargasvarasaMyuktAkzaraviSizwam । eza ca prAyeRa pAdasya padasya cAnte prayojyaH । pAdAntago yaTA “keSaH kASastavakavikAsaH kAyaH prakawitakaraBavilAsaH । cakzurdagDavarAwakakalpaM tyajati na cetaH kAmamanalpam” ॥ padAntago yaTA । “mandaM hasantaH pulakaM vahanta ityAdi । “SabdArTayoH pOnaruktyaM Bede tAtparyyamAtrataH । lAwAnuprAsa ityukto'nuprAsaH paYcaDA tataH” iti । yaTA “smerarAjIvanayane! nayane kiM nimIlite? । paSya nirjitakandarpaM kandarpavaSagaM priyam ॥ atra viBaktyarTasyApOnaruktye'pi muKyatarasya prAtipadikAMSadyItyaDarmmirUpasyABinnArTatvAllAwAnuprAsatvameva । “nayane tasyEva nayane” atra dvitIya nayanaSabdo BAgyavattAdiguRaviSizwatvarUpatAtparyyamAtreRa BinnArTaH । yaTA vA । “yasya na saviDe dayitA davadahanastuhinadIDitistasya । yasya ca saviDe dayitA davadahanastuhinadIDitistasya” ॥ atrAnekapadAnAM pOnarukyam । eza ca prAyeRa lAwajanapriyatvAllAwAnuprAsa” iti ।
m: अनु-प्रास m. alliteration, repetition of similar letters, syllables, and words, Kpr. &c.
a: अनुप्रासः — [अनुगतः रसाद्यनुगुणं प्रकृष्टमासं वर्णन्यासं समवर्णरचनां समवर्णोच्चारणं वा] Alliteration, repetition of similar letters, syllables or sounds; वर्णसाम्यमनुप्रासः K. P. 9; ( स्वरवैसादृश्येऽपि व्यंजनसदृशत्वं वर्णसाम्यं रसाद्यनुगतः प्रकृष्टो न्यासः; अनुप्रासः शब्दसाम्यं वैषम्येपि स्वरस्य यत् S. D. 633.) अनुप्रास is of 5 kinds; (a) छेक˚ or single alliteration; बकुलगंधानंधीकुर्वन्, कावेरीवारिपावनः पवनः; मूर्ध्नामुद्वृत्तकृत्ताविरलगरल &c. K. P. 7. (b) वृत्ति˚ or harmonious. (c) श्रुति˚ or melodious. (d) अंत्य˚ or final; as मंदं हसंतः पुलकं वहंतः. (e) लाट˚; स्मेरराजीवनयने नयने किं निमीलिते. For definitions and examples see S. D. 633-38 and K. P. 9th Ullāsa.
